output.content:
CoreWeave began in New Jersey in 2017 as **Atlantic Crypto**, a cryptocurrency-mining business founded by Michael Intrator, Brian Venturo, Brannin McBee, and Peter Salanki. [[1]] 

Its initial operation used GPU hardware to mine **Ethereum**, rather than Bitcoin; the GPU focus became strategically important because those assets could later be redeployed for cloud computing. [[1]] 

Following the 2018 cryptocurrency-market crash, the company renamed itself **CoreWeave** in 2019 and began using its GPU fleet to provide cloud-computing infrastructure—eventually evolving into an AI-focused GPU cloud provider. [[1]]
